+title: missing-docs runners for Rust and Python, with fixtures
+---
+Ship the first two tool runners for the missing-docs rule in `code-hygiene`.
+
+Rust runner:
+- `scope: workspace`. Command: `cargo clippy --message-format=json -- -W missing_docs`.
+- Map JSON diagnostics; filter to code `missing_docs`. Keep only findings in changed files.
+- Doctor: `which cargo-clippy`. Install: `rustup component add clippy`.
+
+Python runner:
+- `scope: files`. Command: `ruff check --select D1 --output-format json {files}`.
+- Doctor: `which ruff`. Install: pinned ruff via uv / pipx / brew.
+
+Both runners:
+- Ship `fixtures/*.fail.*` (one undocumented public item) and `fixtures/*.pass.*` (fully documented).
+- Exemptions live in tool config or inline suppressions, not prose.
+- The prompt rule `code-hygiene/rules/missing-docs.md` stays as the fallback for other languages.
+
+Acceptance:
+- Real-pipeline test on this repo: `review working` with an undocumented pub item reports it from the Rust runner, with zero LLM calls for that pair.
+- Fixture checks pass in doctor for both runners.
+
+#tool-validators
